title: Serpong Warrior Challenge Run 2026 Review: The Course, Obstacles and Race-Morning Heat
seo_title: Serpong Warrior Challenge Run Review: Course, Obstacles, Cut-offs
meta_description: Serpong Warrior Challenge Run 2026 review: a flat half marathon through Gading Serpong, 7K and 12K obstacle runs, 94% humidity at the 5.15am start, cut-offs, aid and pacers.
dek: What the 27 September 2026 race at Summarecon Mall Serpong set runners: the half-marathon course, the obstacle zones, the weather at the start, the aid stations, cut-offs and pacers, and what runners said about the obstacles in 2025.
verdict: Enter if you want an obstacle run with a real road race attached, or a flat half marathon with pacers. The 2026 half marathon started at 5.15am on a course that never rose above 38 m, with eight water stations, pacers from 100 minutes to a 3:15 sweeper, and a three-and-a-half-hour limit. The 7K and 12K obstacle runs had three and five obstacle zones. The catch is the air. At the start the nearest airport recorded 25°C, a dew point of 24°C and 94% humidity, in haze, and it reached 30°C by 8.30am. Run by effort, not by the flat profile, and use the cooling station at 14 km.

sections.heading: The Half Marathon: A Flat Loop Through Gading Serpong
paragraphs: The 2026 race was held on Sunday 27 September at Summarecon Mall Serpong in Tangerang Selatan. The half marathon started at Gate 1 of the mall and finished at Uptown Park [1][2].

The course stays inside the Gading Serpong township. It heads east past Serpong M-Town and round the Gading Raya golf course, turns south along Jalan Terusan Pondok Hijau Golf with a spur past The Springs Club at 6 to 7 km, and comes back to Jalan Paramount Boulevard at about 10 km. It then runs west past Scientia Square Park and Multimedia Nusantara University, loops south past Cluster Tesla between about 12 and 17 km, and returns along Paramount Boulevard to Uptown Park [3].

It is flat. On the official profile it starts at 28 m, never rises above 38 m and climbs 70 m in total [3]. The organiser calls it a World Athletics certified route designed for personal bests [1], and in 2025 described it as a closed, flat route [4]. Road safety is overseen by the police and the transport authorities [2].

sections.heading: The Obstacle Runs
paragraphs: In 2026 the obstacle runs came in two lengths from the same start: 12 km at 5.35am and 7 km at 6am [5][2]. The 7K map shows three obstacle zones, Warrior Woods at about 4 km, Warrior Labyrinth at 5 km and Warrior Jump at 6 km [6]. The 12K has five obstacles [5], including a Warrior Crawl zone at about 6 km [7]. Both are as flat as the half: the 7K tops out at 32 m with 15 m of climbing, the 12K at 37 m with 30 m [7][6].

In 2025 there was a single 8 km obstacle run with four obstacles and a two-hour limit [8]. Runners from kumparan's running club described it afterwards. One said it was really different from other running events because it was not only on the road, and the obstacles kept it from being boring. Another described the final challenge: a winding maze with artificial rain overhead and climbing plants along it, ending with runners coming out from behind a man-made waterfall into a lake. A third finished with their best time despite the obstacles [9]. The 2026 maps still include a Warrior Labyrinth zone [7][6].
Children aged 4 to 10 had their own obstacle course on the Saturday, at Cluster Mozart in Summarecon Serpong [10][2], with a ramp, a mud crawl, tyres, a balance beam, a bell and a balloon gate [2].

sections.heading: The Weather: 94% Humidity at the Start
paragraphs: Soekarno-Hatta airport, about 13 km north of the start, recorded 25°C at 5am and 5.30am, with a dew point of 24°C, 94% humidity and a 4-knot wind. It warmed to 26°C and 89% humidity at 7am, 28°C at 8am and 30°C with 66% humidity at 8.30am, where it stayed at 9am. The airport reported haze in every observation from 4am to 10.30am [11].

A dew point of 24°C means very wet air, in which sweat barely evaporates, so the flat course is slower than it looks. A two-hour half marathoner finished at about 7.15am, in 26°C to 27°C; runners using the full three and a half hours finished at 8.45am, at about 30°C. The 5K, starting at 6.15am, ran mostly in 25°C to 26°C [11]. The half-marathon map places a cooling station at 14 km [3].

sections.heading: Aid, Cut-offs and Pacers
paragraphs: The half-marathon map shows eight water stations, at about 2.5, 5, 10, 12, 14, 16, 18 and 20 km. The 14 km station also has fruit, energy gel and a cooling station, and there are medic tents, ambulances and medic motorbikes along the course [3]. The rules promise fruit for the half marathon and at the finish, and a rinse station on the half-marathon course [2].

The half marathon had three and a half hours, with checkpoints at 5 km (50 minutes), 10 km (1 hour 40) and 15 km (2 hours 30) [1]. The 12K obstacle run had three hours and the 7K two hours 15 minutes [5]; the 5K had 1 hour 20 minutes [12]. Runners outside the limit get no finisher medal [2]. The start area closes at the official start time, and late arrivals are not allowed to start [2].

Pacers ran at sub-100 minutes, 1:45, 2:00 and 2:15, with a sweeper at 3:15 [1]. Half-marathon finishers got a finisher jersey and medal [1], 12K finishers a finisher jersey and medal [5], and 7K and 5K finishers a medal [5][12].

sections.heading: How the Race Changed From 2025
paragraphs: The 2025 race, on Sunday 5 October, had a half marathon, 10K, 5K, the 8K obstacle run and a kids' obstacle run [9]. Its half marathon started and finished at Uptown Park, at 5.15am with the same three-and-a-half-hour limit, cost Rp800,000 and sold out [13]; the 8K obstacle run cost Rp600,000 and also sold out [8].

For 2026 the 10K was dropped, the obstacle run was split into 7K and 12K, and the start moved to Gate 1 of the mall [1][5][2]. Every 2026 category was marked sold out on the official site [1][5][12][10].

sections.heading: Race Weekend Logistics
paragraphs: Race packs were collected at Unity Lobby, Summarecon Mall Serpong, on Friday 25 September from 10am to 9pm and Saturday 26 September from 10am to 7pm; kids' packs on the Friday only. A representative needed a signed authorisation letter and a copy of the runner's ID [2].

On race morning, race central opened at 3am and runners reached the start through Unity Lobby [2]. Bags went into mobile drop-bag vans near the start and were collected at Uptown Park, between 4am and 9.30am; only the official race bag was accepted, and no phones or other electronics [2]. Taxis and ride-hailing cars pick up from the mall's north lobby, and runners who drive can park across the mall's car parks [2].

Fees are not refunded, but an entry can be transferred to someone else or switched to another race while places remain [14]; bibs cannot be handed over without the organiser's approval [2]. Only Indonesians and foreigners holding a KITAS can win podium places; other foreigners run non-competitively [2]. Half-marathon national winners got Rp20 million and each master age group from 40-44 to 55+ Rp7 million [1]; the 5K paid Rp12 million to its winners [2]; obstacle-run podiums got product packages [5]. BRI's app offered 50% off entry in 2026 [15].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2027 Race?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want an obstacle run built on a proper road course, a flat half marathon with a full set of pacers, or a family weekend with a kids' course on the Saturday.

Think twice if you struggle in humid air, since a flat profile does not help much at 94% humidity, or if you are a foreigner without a KITAS hoping for prize money. The half-marathon course also winds through a residential township rather than a city centre.
No 2027 date had been published, and no results or reports of how the 2026 race went had appeared two days after it. The 2026 races all sold out, so watch the official site for the next edition.

Nobody from this site ran the race. This review draws on the organiser's race guide, rules and course maps, airport weather records, sponsor coverage, and runners' accounts of the 2025 edition published by kumparan.

faqs.question: What is the obstacle course like at the Serpong Warrior Challenge Run?
faqs.answer: Short zones built into a flat run. In 2026 the 7K had three, called Warrior Woods, Warrior Labyrinth and Warrior Jump, and the 12K had five. In 2025 the 8K ended in a winding maze under artificial rain, with runners coming out from behind a man-made waterfall into a lake.

faqs.question: What are the cut-off times at the Serpong Warrior Challenge Run?
faqs.answer: In 2026 the half marathon had three and a half hours, with checkpoints at 5 km (50 minutes), 10 km (1 hour 40) and 15 km (2 hours 30). The 12K obstacle run had three hours, the 7K two hours 15 minutes and the 5K 1 hour 20. Runners outside the limit get no medal.

faqs.question: How hot is it at the Serpong Warrior Challenge Run?
faqs.answer: Warm and very humid. At the 5.15am half-marathon start in 2026, Soekarno-Hatta airport, about 13 km away, recorded 25°C, a dew point of 24°C and 94% humidity, with haze. By 8.30am it was 30°C. The half-marathon course has a cooling station at 14 km.

faqs.question: Can foreigners win prizes at the Serpong Warrior Challenge Run?
faqs.answer: Only if they hold a KITAS. Podium places and prize money are for Indonesian citizens and foreign KITAS holders; other foreigners can enter but run non-competitively. In 2026 the half-marathon national winners received Rp20 million each and the 5K winners Rp12 million.

faqs.question: Can you transfer a Serpong Warrior Challenge Run entry?
faqs.answer: Yes, through the organiser. The 2026 terms allowed an entry to be passed to another person or switched to another race while places remained, but bibs cannot be handed over without the organiser's approval, and unauthorised sales lead to disqualification. Entry fees are not refunded.

editorial_notes: Rewritten 2026-09-29 about the 27 September 2026 edition, two days after the race. No news report or runner account of how the 2026 race went had been published, so the review covers the course, schedule, cut-offs and aid as the organiser set them, the observed race-morning weather, and runners' accounts of the 2025 obstacle run. Those accounts are from members of kumparan's own running club, published by kumparan. Results (ScoreNow) were behind a bot check, so there is no field-depth section. Aid-station positions are read from the official course map. The rules PDF still lists an '8K Obstacle' cut-off; the site and maps show 7K, which is used. No rating.
